hook: Telangana seeks *$430 million* urban plan with World Bank help
hook_b: Telangana seeks *$430 million* urban plan with World Bank help
tldr: The Telangana Urban Transformation and Jobs Program targets towns in the PURE and RARE regions outside the ORR.

beats.what: It aims to fix municipal finances, support municipal bonds and fund climate-resilient water, sanitation and drainage.
beats.why: Only a few urban local bodies are creditworthy; most depend on State and central transfers.
beats.care: Fast-growing peri-urban towns could get better drains, water and public spaces if it is approved.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: TUFIDC would act as the financial intermediary, and the project would reward towns that improve their finances.

facts.t: The IBRD would extend a *$300 million* Programme for Results loan.

Mostly loan-funded, adds to State borrowing

learn.t: PURE / RARE = Peri-Urban and Rural Agricultural Regional Economy zones in the Telangana Rising 2047 plan.

watch: Whether the World Bank approves the programme next year, and which towns are picked.

fact: Telangana seeks World Bank help for a *$430 million* urban programme.
twist: The World Bank would lend *$300 million*; the State funds the other $130 million, with approval likely next year.
